card.profile: The beating heart of the Andes — Huayno (Peru, Andes). Full sourced 9-field A+ profile in research artifact W7; concise schema stub pending text expansion.
card.image_significance: The beating heart of the Andes. A representative image shows colorful regional costume and lively partner or troupe footwork — Andes, Peru.

observation.setting: Stage of a theater with a backdrop screen showing a mountain landscape (Machu Picchu), theatrical lighting, and live musicians on stage.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of about 10 adult dancers (men and women).
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers start in a line at the side, move into a scattered group formation, form lines, circles, and pairs while traveling across the stage.
observation.posture: Upright torso, upright carriage with energetic knee action and weight shifts.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and hopping on the beat with lifted heels; rapid intricate footwork cannot be clearly detailed due to distance and video resolution.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held up and curving overhead or out to the sides, frequently waving or holding folded cloths, scarves, or handkerchiefs.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright while spinning and turning; skirts flair with hip and body rotation.
observation.partnering: Couples dance in proximity, sometimes holding scarves or handkerchiefs between them, or circling around each other without heavy physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent rapid turns and spins, a sequence where all dancers drop to low knee or floor levels and rise back up.
observation.costume_and_props: Women wear patterned tiered skirts, embroidered vests, and red hats; men wear dark trousers, white shirts, patterned ponchos, and red hats. Dancers hold scarves, cloths, or handkerchiefs.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact intricate footwork patterns, subtle upper body isolations, and exact finger or hand gestures due to distance and video resolution.

signature_moments.what: Dancers spin rapidly in place while holding up scarves with both hands.
Dancers drop simultaneously to a low crouch on the floor while waving scarves.
Pairs of dancers circle underneath lifted arches made of scarves held between partners.
